stories.title: Marvel's Wolverine Walkthrough (4K) - Telambang (Prologue Missions) - IGN
stories.summary: In this Wolverine walkthrough, we'll be going through the opening three missions that take place in Telambang. These are essentially the tutorial/prologue missions. We'll be playing on The Weapon difficulty for these intro missions (second hardest level), but for the main game we'll be playing on the hardest difficulty, The Best There Is. We plan on getting all major collectibles (Whisky Bottles, Nightmare Doors, Material Crates) during this playthrough as well, but you don't need to worry about any of those for these opening missions.These missions wrap up with a boss fight against Omega Red.Back in Action mission00:00 - Opening cutscene03:00 - Start of gameplay 21:21 - Not a "true" collectible, but these canisters will provide XP every time you break them22:45 - Again, not a "true" collectible, but environmental objects will provide extra loreA Debt Repaid mission31:03 - Audio logs are also not "true" collectibles, but will provide lore and a small amount of XP41:26 - Knee Breaker is the most important skill you can get early in the game as it will boost the stagger level a great deal on bosses and mini-bossesLast Meal mission51:05 - Boss fight (Omega Red)

stories.title: Marvel's Wolverine Walkthrough - Canada (All Crates, Doors, Whisky Bottles) - IGN
